modelspec.data.DenseDataDirectory.title: DenseDataDirectory
modelspec.data.DenseDataDirectory.description: The directory `modelspec train --data <dir>` or `--eval <dir>` names (DESIGN.md § 8). It holds one DenseTensorFile per `input` and `target` declaration of the train block, all with the same samples count N, and for `--data` an optional SampleOrder. Under `--eval` the order is not read and N must be a multiple of B, else E-DATA-009 before the first step.
x-ess-invariants: distinct tensor in tensors by tensor.name

modelspec.data.DenseTensorFile.title: DenseTensorFile
modelspec.data.DenseTensorFile.description: One file `<name>.f32` of a dense data directory, read by `modelspec train --data` and `--eval` (DESIGN.md § 8). name is the name of an `input` or `target` declaration `name Tensor<f32, [B, d1, ...]>` of the train block; the file is row-major little-endian f32 with no header, one sample per sample_elements = d1 × ... values, so samples is the file length in bytes divided by 4 × sample_elements. A length that is not a whole number of samples, no sample at all, or a value that is NaN or infinite is refused with E-DATA-007 before the first step.

modelspec.data.SampleOrder.title: SampleOrder
modelspec.data.SampleOrder.description: The optional file `order.u32` of a dense data directory, little-endian u32 sample indices with no header. Training step k feeds the samples indices[k·B .. (k+1)·B]; without the file it feeds the samples (k·B + i) mod N. The loss after the last update reads the batch of step `steps`, its positions taken modulo the count of indices. Fewer than steps · B indices, or an index not below the directory's sample count N, is refused with E-DATA-008 before the first step.
